svg.title: What Shotlight does
svg.desc: Six features: naming on capture, search by any word, guarding secrets, Tidy Up, rules, and searchable recordings.

g.text: Read on-device by Apple Vision and
Apple Intelligence. Undo is one click.
“can I get a refund on the annual…”
Text inside, app, name, even what
was said in a screen recording.
Keys, passwords, cards and codes are
blurred and kept out of search.
Preview every new name, rename in
Write a rule like a sentence. New
Speech is transcribed on your Mac.
Search a word, the clip starts there.
